$description: Structured brand guidelines — the single source for the Storybook Foundations pages, brand.json, and the lab_brand MCP server. Token names refer to tokens.json / tokens.flat.json; file paths are repo-relative. staywire: the API-first booking engine's brand — light-first, editorial serif display, ink-is-the-loudest-pixel, wire-indigo signature.

items.name: Ink
items.usage: Primary text and the loudest pixel — primary CTAs on light.

items.name: Paper
items.usage: The light canvas. Cool paper, faint blue cast.

items.name: White
items.usage: Cards and figure surfaces — one step above paper.

items.name: Deep paper
items.usage: Inset wells: code windows, terminal shells.

items.name: Mist
items.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Depth without shadows.

items.name: Ash
items.usage: Tertiary text, footer copy, disabled labels.

items.name: Indigo
items.usage: The signature — links, focus ring, selected. Scarce by rule.

items.name: Indigo deep
items.usage: Hover / active state. A state, not a second brand colour.

items.name: Indigo wash
items.usage: Subtle tint surfaces — chips, selected rows, washes.

items.name: Night
items.usage: Dark canvas — ink as a surface.

items.name: Night raised
items.usage: Dark cards, one luminance step up.

items.name: Night deep
items.usage: Dark code wells — cooler and darker than canvas.

items.name: Paper on night
items.usage: Primary text on dark; the dark mode's brightest pixel (primary CTA).

faces.role: Display — hero and section headlines only
Body + UI — everything that isn't a headline or code
Code wells, inline code, delivery-log figures

styles.label: Headline (H1)
styles.sample: Direct bookings, confirmed on the wire.

styles.label: Body (B1)
styles.sample: staywire is the engine between a property's website and a confirmed guest. Availability, quotes, and bookings ride one public API — the same one the admin, the embed, and booking agents use. Double-booking is impossible at the database layer, so the copy never has to hedge.

styles.label: Body large
styles.sample: The best way to take a booking is directly — on your own site, at your own rates.

styles.label: Caption
styles.sample: Rates shown in the property's currency. Taxes itemized at quote time.

art.name: Wire fields
art.description: No art assets ship yet — the art direction (thin wire strokes with node dots, drawn in mist/indigo on paper) is specified but blocked on a brand drop. Every surface must degrade gracefully to pure typography.
